notes: Clicked for credits up to 22 credits for many turns without installing a rig, and kept rerunning breakerless into Anansi and IP Block, shredding its own hand and losing clicks to tags. It never challenged the remote where the corp scored.

Slow, click-heavy economy and several naked remote installs, but the traps and the Komainu-guarded remote ground the runner's hand down for a sensible flatline win. Drawing into a full hand on turn 1 was a minor waste.

Spent eleven turns at 1-2 credits making four HQ runs a turn while never trashing the corp's runaway economy assets. Later, sitting on 6 points with 20-40 credits, it clicked for credits and tried to play the unplayable Moshing every turn until the corp scored out.
Built and layered a scoring remote, used Advanced Assembly Lines well and scored out steadily. The only blemishes were a few draws into a full hand and losing one agenda behind two Magnets.

Good early R&D/HQ pressure put it on 5 points by turn 4, but it took 16 more turns to close against a broke corp. Repeated low-value HQ runs and a 9-credit Femme Fatale that was never used were the main waste.

Clicked for credits for about nine turns while discarding from a full hand, leaving agendas flooding HQ behind a single ice; three were stolen from HQ. The last agenda went into a one-ice remote and was stolen for the loss.

Sat at 0-3 credits for most of the game (Drug Dealer drain, Calling in Favors for nothing) and made a couple of breakerless runs into ETR ice. It still read correctly that Archives was the corp's weak point and won there.
Ran open R&D four times a turn, mostly re-seeing the same top card, and never built an economy or rig. The corp scored four agendas from a one-ice remote that the runner never contested.

Installed an agenda behind ice it could not afford to rez, and the runner stole it. From turn 12 to 22 it clicked for credits with 10-33 credits against a broke runner, discarding every turn instead of using its four-ice remote to close.
Scored efficiently with fast advances and won on turn 13. It did leave Corporate Sales Team behind only Architect, which has no end-the-run subroutine, and that agenda was stolen.

Ran a fast remote scoring plan, but left R&D unprotected for four turns while the runner hit it four times a turn, giving up four agendas and nearly the game. It iced HQ before R&D despite that pressure.
Hammered open R&D with good economy cards and Mad Dash, cleared tags efficiently and closed with Dirty Laundry on HQ by turn 8. It had only small sequencing inefficiencies.

Idled for several early turns, drawing and clicking credits with 13-18 credits and a full hand, before building a remote. Late on it put Élivágar Bifurcation behind a single Magnet while low on credits and lost it, though it still scored out.

Clicked for credits up to 45 credits and never ran the corp's scoring remote. It then ran Archives about 15 times in a row, declining to steal Obokata Protocol each time even when it could survive the damage.

Took an early steal, trashed economy assets, used Engolo and Ika correctly on Anansi and pressured R&D. It drew up to exactly enough cards to survive the 4 net damage and steal Obokata Protocol for the win.

Never installed an agenda and clicked for credits most turns. It repeatedly fired Anoetic Void, trashing agendas from HQ into an unprotected Archives; once it could no longer pay, the runner took four agendas from Archives in one run.
Used Mad Dash on Archives after Audacity, hit the remote while the corp was broke, and broke Magnet with Black Orchestra to steal from R&D for a fast win. Its play was sound throughout.
Built a three-ice remote and then never used it, putting Fetal AI twice and a Mushin'd House of Knives into naked remotes, where all three were stolen. Many idle credit clicks filled the rest.

Made solid use of Assembly Lines and Seamless Launch, iced its remotes before advancing, and scored 7 points by turn 12 without losing an agenda. A few filler draw and credit clicks were the only waste.

After the opening Legwork steal it spent about 15 turns drawing into a reduced hand and discarding while clicking to 39 credits, never installing breakers. It let the corp advance and score agendas in lightly defended remotes unchallenged.
